question.value: Does the isolated Bok globule protostar B335 (IRAS 19347+0727) harbor a hot corino, i.e. compact emission from saturated complex organic molecules?

evidence.quote: We report the first evidence of a hot corino in a Bok globule.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.01102.S.
We conducted the 1.2 mm (250 GHz) observation (Band 6) of B335 with ALMA (Cycle 2) on May 18, 2015.

findings_qualitative.value: COM lines are broad (5-8 km/s) with no obvious rotation and are unresolved, so COMs lie in a structure much smaller than the beam

evidence.quote: Though the COMs lines are as broad as 5-8 km s$^{-1}$, they do not show obvious rotation motion in the present observation.

findings_qualitative.value: CCH and c-C3H2 are extended over a few 100 au; sulfur-bearing species have compact and extended components

evidence.quote: Carbon-chain related molecules, CCH and c-C$_3$H$_2$, are also found in this source, whose distributions are extended over a few 100 au scale.

claims.hypothesis: Does B335, an isolated Bok globule protostar, harbor a hot corino?
claims.experiment: ALMA Band 6 line survey, LTE column densities and abundances relative to H2, compared with other sources
claims.result: CH3CHO, HCOOCH3, NH2CHO detected in compact region; COM abundances comparable to known hot corinos and much higher than prestellar core L1689B
claims.finding: B335 harbors a hot corino, the first identified in a Bok globule

evidence.quote: we conclude that B335 harbors a hot corino.

claims.hypothesis: Does NH2CHO abundance correlate with HNCO in B335?
claims.experiment: Compared the NH2CHO/HNCO ratio with star-forming-region values

evidence.quote: Hence, the positive correlation between the abundances of these two species indeed holds in B335.

claims.hypothesis: Can the emitting size and protostellar mass be constrained despite no resolution?
claims.finding: Consistent with Yen et al. mass limit

evidence.quote: It is 0.02 $M_\odot$ or higher, if the motion is infall.

why_this_data.value: B335 is an isolated Bok globule free from environmental effects of other protostars, so it is an ideal target

evidence.quote: B335 is an ideal target for this purpose.

limitations_admitted.value: COM distribution is not resolved; acetone detection tentative; angular resolution insufficient to see distribution trends

evidence.quote: probably because of the insufficient angular resolution in this study
